'''Sarus-Dor''' was one of the [[Capital/Legends|capital cities]] of [[Typha-Dor]], along with [[Ith-Dor]].

A planetary space center, at which the [[Typha-Dor High Council]] met for high security and strategic planning meetings, lay between the two capitals. The High Council consisted of the world's "twin rulers," its [[High General]], and a cadre of lesser [[General/Legends|generals]].
